entities.summary: Derick Brassard is a Canadian professional ice hockey centre who currently plays for Genève-Servette HC of the National League (NL). He previously played 16 seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Columbus Blue Jackets, New York Rangers, Ottawa Senators, Pittsburgh Penguins, Florida Panthers, Colorado Avalanche, New York Islanders, Arizona Coyotes, Philadelphia Flyers and Edmonton Oilers. The Blue Jackets selected him in the first round, sixth overall, of the 2006 NHL entry draft.
